notable_features.text: Turkish is an SOV language with a large phoneme inventory of 40 sounds and marks 7 distinct tense/aspect categories, reflecting a rich verbal morphology typical of its Turkic family. As the most widely spoken Turkic language, with roughly 90 million speakers centered in Turkey and Cyprus, it also has notable speaker communities across Europe, the South Caucasus, and parts of Central Asia and the Middle East.
